question.worked_solution:
Recall that 

$$
\int \csc^2 x \, \textrm dx = -\cot x + C
$$

and

$$
\int \csc x \cot x \, \textrm dx = -\csc x + C.
$$

Therefore, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \operatorname{csc}⁡x(\operatorname{csc}⁡x+3\operatorname{cot}⁡x)\,\text{d}x & =\int {csc}^{2}⁡x+3\operatorname{csc}⁡x\operatorname{cot}⁡x\,\text{d}x \\  & =\int {csc}^{2}⁡x\,\text{d}x+3\int \operatorname{csc}⁡x\operatorname{cot}⁡x\,\text{d}x \\  & =-\operatorname{cot}⁡x-3\operatorname{csc}⁡x+C.\end{aligned}
$$
